coverage.method: Sitemap/navigation discovery, page-family HTML/CSS inspection, selected browser screenshots and runtime probes where permitted.
coverage.viewports: 1440px desktop and 390px mobile; not every source page was rendered.
coverage.limits: Public page families sampled, not every article, locale, private app or interaction state. Source-only theme/motion declarations are not runtime verification.

color.background: Marketing body observed lab(98.846 0.111073 0.751436), a near-white warm ground; #fbf9f4 remains a source cream surface, not a universal page fill.

warm_family.note: warm amber tints used for callout/highlight surfaces against the cream base

color.temperature: warm neutrals (stone/cream), cool single-hue blue accent

typography.fonts: DM Sans marketing headings and body; Inter inside the editor demo; JetBrains Mono for labels/code. Docs use system sans.
typography.marketing: Home h1 60/60, weight 300, tracking -1.5px; at 390px 48/48, tracking -1.2px. Body 16/24.
typography.voice: Light proportional headline + uppercase mono labels; editor prose is a separate typographic layer.

spacing.density: airy — generous section gaps, roomy card padding
spacing.section_rhythm: consistent large vertical bands, each with mono eyebrow + light headline

layout.max_width: Home hero text about 938px at 1440px, wider demo frame below; the older 42rem text cap is not the homepage frame.
layout.structure: hero with product demo window, alternating feature sections, CTA, minimal footer
layout.alignment: mostly centered hero, left-aligned section content
layout.mobile: 390px: 48px light headline; agent selector remains horizontal; demo prioritizes the document pane and hides the desktop chat split.
layout.docs: Separate Fumadocs shell: system sans, left search/nav, main article, right TOC/newsletter and floating Ask AI.

shape.dominant: rounded-full is the most-used radius class — pills everywhere

elevation.philosophy: hairline borders first, shadows second; all shadows soft and low-alpha

motion.reveals: ok-reveal-in: fade + 4px translateY; ok-block-reveal: fade + 7px translateY

components.primary_button: pill, uppercase label, bg primary, white text, lift on hover
components.cards: white on cream, hairline border, soft panel shadow
components.chips_badges: small rounded-full tags; doc/data/code chip color variants
components.product_windows: faux app windows with toolbars, tabs, and timeline UI as hero imagery
components.inputs: rounded-full with inset pill button, ring-2 primary focus states

design_style.mood: Calm, light, warm technical paper with one azure action color.
design_style.composition: Centered light headline and mono labels above a wide live document/agent demo. Dot-grid margins, pill controls and rounded demo frames provide structure.
design_style.imagery: Product documents, agent conversations, tabs and timelines; pale sky/peach/mint backdrop assets and occasional blue hexagon accents. Docs use a functional three-column shell.
design_style.interaction: Lightweight tabbed demo choreography; clearly marked download and copy affordances.

visual_effects.technology: No canvas in rendered homepage or docs samples; CSS/DOM demos and static image/SVG backdrops.
visual_effects.reveals: ok-reveal-in observed at 360ms; rich-fade-up at 500ms with 80ms stagger. Other source reveal utilities use 4–7px vertical travel.
visual_effects.demo: Agent selector changes the conversation; document preview renders rich markdown, labels and task states. Mobile emphasizes the document rather than scaling the whole desktop demo.
visual_effects.surfaces: Dot grid, static gradient image backgrounds, translucent glass panels where used (20px blur, 28px radius, cool soft shadow); these are not evidence of WebGL.
visual_effects.scope: Dark tokens are shipped; this refresh rendered light marketing and light docs only.

page_families./: Wide agent/document demo, blue pill CTA and dot-grid backdrop.
page_families./docs/get-started/overview: System-font documentation, blue selected nav and code/copy controls; does not inherit DM Sans display sizes.
page_families./blog; /blog/markdownlint-support: Editorial list/detail in the shared brand shell.
page_families./brand; /download; /launch-week: Brand assets, platform selection and launch collection.
page_families./d/…: Public rendered markdown document rather than a marketing landing.
